notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335398/b5b4bf867332d589a8eeca22fe6f989dbd50eaf1.png[/img]
Thank you for playing GIRLS MADE PUDDING. We’ve just released a new update.

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added the item “Sumibi’s cat-ear frothy black-sesame latte.”
[*]Added the item “Nikomi’s cat-ear fizzy grape squash.”
[*]After clearing the main story, the “Circus” will now appear on the map.
[/list][h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the DualSense controller was not functioning correctly.
[*]Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would appear while using a controller.
[*]Corrected typos and text errors.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335398/494f37bf68d1ec5244504c35a54dee0625186120.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335398/86b2bfda980ad2770a80a104afcfb37f9c22f1f8.png[/img]

We hope you continue to enjoy GIRLS MADE PUDDING!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.0
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "GIRLS MADE PUDDING". We have just released an update.

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new Tapes featuring character voices for Sumibi and Nikomi, performed by kahoca, Muto, Ichinose Himari, and m. These can be found as items after clearing the game.
[*] Added 13 new Meals.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the explanation in Topics to make it easier to locate the Laboratory and Hut. Also made them appear in some maps where they previously didn't.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could become unplayable on the "STORY" difficulty.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could become unplayable after acquiring the Topic "Sumibi #2".
[*] Fixed a bug in the Amida-kuji mini-game where the window wouldn't close after the time limit expired.
[*] Corrected typos and omissions.
[/list]
We hope you continue to enjoy  "GIRLS MADE PUDDING".
